name: facil.io
listed_description: Mini-framework for web applications. Includes a fast HTTP and Websocket server, and also supports custom protocols.
reason: No numeric comparison against nginx, Apache or any named baseline reachable. The project site facil.io is blocked from this environment; its source (docs/index.html and docs/_SOURCE/index.md in boazsegev/facil.io) only says it 'provides high performance TCP/IP network services' and refers to the C10K problem. The repo README, CHANGELOG.md (only mentions the TechEmpower Framework Benchmarks being run at 80 cores, no figures), the TechEmpower facil.io README (lists JSON and PLAINTEXT tests, no results), the facil-io/cstl README and a general web-framework benchmark repo contain no numbers for it. Directional claim only.

name: facil.io
listed_description: Evented, high performance C web framework supporting HTTP, WebSockets, SSE and more.
reason: Same project as the facil.io entry above (MIT, 2.4k stars; development has moved to facil-io/cstl). The only third-party comparison found is a dev.to post benchmarking a facil.io app against Flask (Gunicorn) and Node.js on a 1 GB single-core VM (code at wickdChromosome/simple_webapp_comparison, whose README holds no numbers); the post itself is blocked here and its search snippet says facil.io showed no clear response-time advantage, only slightly lower RAM use. TechEmpower round results were not reachable. No number against a named baseline was obtained.
